children: Overview
China CDMO's Q3 revenue rose 24% yr/yr to RMB 1.79 bln
Net profit attributable to shareholders increased 81.5% yr/yr
Growth driven by chemical macromolecules, biological macromolecules, and drug product segments
Outlook
Company expects full-year 2026 operating revenue to increase by 19% to 22%
Q4 delivery scale is expected to increase significantly versus Q3, supported by its order backlog
Result Drivers
MACROMOLECULAR SEGMENTS - Co said Q3 growth was mainly driven by strong performance in chemical macromolecules, biological macromolecules, and drug product segments
EMERGING BUSINESS GROWTH - Revenue from emerging businesses rose sharply, with gross profit margin of 30.95% in Q3
OPERATING EFFICIENCY - Co said shift to 'cost control and efficiency improvement' approach enhanced profitability and competitiveness
